structure.en: Affirmative:  Subject + V1   (add -s / -es for he, she, it)
structure.fa: مثبت:   فاعل + فعل پایه   (برای he/she/it فعل s/es می‌گیرد)

structure.en: Negative:     Subject + do / does + not + V1
structure.fa: منفی:   فاعل + do/does + not + فعل پایه

structure.en: Question:     Do / Does + subject + V1 ?
structure.fa: سؤالی:  Do/Does + فاعل + فعل پایه ؟

structure.en: Short answer: Yes, he does.  /  No, he doesn't.
structure.fa: پاسخ کوتاه: Yes, he does.  /  No, he doesn't.

explain.en: The -s appears only in the third person singular (he, she, it) and only in the affirmative: 'She works', but 'She does not work' and 'Does she work?'.
explain.fa: حرف s فقط در سوم‌شخص مفرد (he/she/it) و فقط در حالت مثبت می‌آید: «She works» درست است، ولی «She does not work» و «Does she work؟» بدون s هستند.

explain.en: Spelling of the -s: most verbs just add -s (plays); verbs ending in -o, -sh, -ch, -ss, -x add -es (goes, watches, fixes); consonant + y becomes -ies (study → studies, but play → plays).
explain.fa: املای s: بیشتر افعال فقط s می‌گیرند (plays)؛ افعالی که به o، sh، ch، ss، x ختم می‌شوند es می‌گیرند (goes, watches, fixes)؛ و بعد از بی‌صدا + y به شکل in می‌روند (study → studies ولی play → plays).

explain.en: Do not use the present simple for what is happening right now: 'I am eating now', not 'I eat now'. The present simple states a fact or a habit, not a moment.
explain.fa: حال ساده برای اتفاق لحظه‌ای به کار نمی‌رود: «I am eating now» درست است نه «I eat now». حال ساده بیان‌گر عادت و حقیقت است، نه لحظه‌ی حال.

tip.en: Used for habits, routines and general truths. The third person singular always takes -s / -es, and the negative and question forms need do / does.
tip.fa: برای عادت‌ها، روتین و حقایق کلیه. سوم‌شخص مفرد همیشه s/es می‌گیرد و منفی/سؤالی به do/does نیاز دارد.

structure.en: Singular subject → verb with -s: He works. · Plural subject → base verb: They work.
structure.fa: فاعل مفرد ← فعل با s: He works. · فاعل جمع ← فعل پایه: They work.

structure.en: each, every, everyone, one of + plural noun → singular verb: Each of the students has a book.
structure.fa: each, every, everyone, one of + اسم جمع ← فعل مفرد: Each of the students has a book.

structure.en: either … or / neither … nor → the verb agrees with the nearer subject: Either you or he is right.
structure.fa: either … or / neither … nor ← فعل با فاعل نزدیک‌تر هماهنگ می‌شود: Either you or he is right.

structure.en: Uncountable nouns and subject names are singular: The news is good. · Physics is hard.
structure.fa: اسم‌های غیرقابل‌شمارش و نام درس‌ها مفرد هستند: The news is good. · Physics is hard.

structure.en: A collective noun takes a singular verb: The team is winning.
structure.fa: اسم جمعی فعل مفرد می‌گیرد: The team is winning.

structure.en: With there / here the verb agrees with the noun after it: There is one problem. / There are two problems.
structure.fa: با there / here فعل با اسمِ بعد از خودش هماهنگ می‌شود: There is one problem. / There are two problems.

explain.en: The -s marks the third person singular, not plurality: 'The student works' but 'The students work'. Persian marks the plural on the verb, English marks it only on the subject, so learners often reverse the two.
explain.fa: s نشانه‌ی سوم‌شخص مفرد است، نه جمع: «The student works» اما «The students work». فارسی جمع را روی فعل نشان می‌دهد و انگلیسی فقط روی فاعل، برای همین زبان‌آموزها این دو را جابه‌جا می‌کنند.

explain.en: When two subjects are joined by 'with', 'as well as' or 'together with', the verb follows the FIRST subject: 'The teacher, with her students, is here.'
explain.fa: وقتی دو فاعل با with، as well as یا together with وصل شوند، فعل با فاعل اول هماهنگ می‌شود: «The teacher, with her students, is here».

explain.en: 'A number of + plural' is plural (a number of students are), but 'the number of + plural' is singular (the number of students is growing). The article changes the subject.
explain.fa: «A number of + جمع» جمع است (a number of students are)، ولی «the number of + جمع» مفرد است (the number of students is growing). حرف تعریف فاعل را عوض می‌کند.

function.en: Keep the verb and the subject in step in long sentences
function.fa: در جمله‌های بلند فعل و فاعل را هماهنگ نگه دار

function.en: Handle quantifier subjects: each, every, none, either
function.fa: فاعل‌های مقدار: each، every، none، either

function.en: Use uncountable and subject nouns correctly
function.fa: اسم‌های غیرقابل‌شمارش و نام درس‌ها را درست به کار ببر

function.en: Agree with there is / there are
function.fa: هماهنگی با there is / there are

examples.en: **Each of the answers is** correct.
**Neither of the boys was** ready.
**The news is** good.
**Here comes** the bus.
**Ten kilometres is** a long way to walk.

tip.en: Find the real subject, not the word next to the verb: 'one of the + plural' is singular, 'a number of + plural' is plural.
tip.fa: فاعل واقعی را پیدا کن، نه واژه‌ی کنار فعل: «one of the + جمع» مفرد است، «a number of + جمع» جمع.

q.fa: هر یک از دانشجوها لپ‌تاپ دارد.

structure.en: Affirmative:  I am  ·  You / We / They are  ·  He / She / It is
structure.fa: مثبت:   I am  ·  You / We / They are  ·  He / She / It is

structure.en: Negative:     am not  ·  isn't  ·  aren't
structure.fa: منفی:   am not  ·  isn't  ·  aren't

structure.en: Question:     Am I …?  Are you …?  Is he …?  (the verb comes first)
structure.fa: سؤالی:   Am I …?  Are you …?  Is he …?  (فعل اول می‌آید)

structure.en: Short answer: Yes, I am.  /  No, I'm not.
structure.fa: پاسخ کوتاه: Yes, I am.  /  No, I'm not.

structure.en: Contractions: I'm · you're · he's · it's · we're · they're
structure.fa: شکل کوتاه: I'm · you're · he's · it's · we're · they're

structure.en: Note: to be can NEVER be dropped — 'I am a student', not 'I student'
structure.fa: نکته: فعل to be هرگز حذف نمی‌شود — «I am a student»، نه «I student»

explain.en: In negatives and questions the subject and the verb swap: 'He is happy' → 'Is he happy?'. This inversion is what makes a question in English — no helper word is needed.
explain.fa: در منفی و سؤال، فاعل و فعل جایشان عوض می‌شود: «He is happy» → «Is he happy؟». همین جابه‌جایی در انگلیسی سؤال می‌سازد و نیازی به واژه‌ی کمکی نیست.

explain.en: The verb can never be dropped, even when Persian drops it: 'Ali student' ✗ → 'Ali is a student' ✓. Every English sentence needs a verb.
explain.fa: فعل را هرگز حذف نکن، حتی جایی که فارسی حذف می‌کند: «Ali student» غلط است و «Ali is a student» درست. هر جمله‌ی انگلیسی به فعل نیاز دارد.

explain.en: 'It' is the dummy subject for weather, time, distance and impersonal statements: It is cold · It is five o'clock · It is far from here.
explain.fa: ضمیر It برای آب‌وهوا، زمان، فاصله و جمله‌های بی‌فاعل به کار می‌رود: It is cold · It is five o'clock · It is far from here.

function.en: Identity and description (She is a doctor)
function.fa: هویت و توصیف (او دکتر است)

function.en: Feelings, states, age (I am hungry, He is ten)
function.fa: احساسات، حالت‌ها، سن (گرسنه‌ام، ده سالشه)

function.en: Weather, time and dates (It is cold, It is 5 o'clock)
function.fa: هوا، ساعت و تاریخ (هوا سرده، ساعت ۵ است)

function.en: AUXILIARY in continuous forms (I am reading)
function.fa: فعل کمکی در زمان استمراری (دارم می‌خونم)

function.en: AUXILIARY in the passive voice (The letter was written)
function.fa: فعل کمکی در مجهول (نامه نوشته شد)

function.en: After a preposition to express position (She is at home)
function.fa: بعد از حرف اضافه برای موقعیت (او خونه‌ست)

She **isn't** at home now.
**Are** you **ready**?
The weather **is** beautiful today.
They **are** reading a book.
It **was** cold yesterday.
The keys **are** on the shelf.
I'm **not** tired — I'm just busy.

tip.en: The one verb you cannot drop. Remember: he is NOT 'he'.
tip.fa: تنها فعلی که هرگز حذف نمی‌شود: او «he» نیست.

q.en: The book ____ on the table. (to be)
There ____ a lot of people at the party.
I ____ a student, not a teacher.

structure.en: There is + singular or uncountable · There are + plural: There is a book. / There are three books.
structure.fa: There is + مفرد یا غیرقابل‌شمارش · There are + جمع: There is a book. / There are three books.

structure.en: Past: There was + singular · There were + plural.
structure.fa: گذشته: There was + مفرد · There were + جمع.

structure.en: Questions: Is there …? / Are there …? — Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.
structure.fa: سؤالی: Is there …? / Are there …? — Yes, there is. / No, there aren't.

structure.en: Negative: There isn't / There aren't + noun.
structure.fa: منفی: There isn't / There aren't + اسم.

structure.en: The verb agrees with the noun AFTER it: There is a lot of noise. / There are a lot of people.
structure.fa: فعل با اسمی که بعد از آن می‌آید هماهنگ است: There is a lot of noise. / There are a lot of people.

structure.en: Use it to say that something exists, not where it is: There is a bank near here.
structure.fa: با آن می‌گوییم چیزی وجود دارد، نه اینکه کجاست: There is a bank near here.

explain.en: 'There' is not a place here — it is a placeholder that lets English put the new information at the end of the sentence. 'A problem is' sounds broken; 'There is a problem' is natural.
explain.fa: «there» اینجا به معنی «آنجا» نیست؛ جای‌نگهدار است تا انگلیسی اطلاعات تازه را آخر جمله بگذارد. «A problem is» ناقص است، ولی «There is a problem» طبیعی است.

explain.en: Agreement looks forward, at the noun that follows: There is some milk (uncountable) but There are some eggs (plural). The word 'there' itself is never plural.
explain.fa: هماهنگی به اسمِ بعد از فعل نگاه می‌کند: «There is some milk» (غیرقابل‌شمارش) ولی «There are some eggs» (جمع). خودِ «there» هرگز جمع نمی‌شود.

explain.en: In fast speech people say 'There's two tickets', but in writing and in exams keep There are for plurals.
explain.fa: در گفتار سریع می‌شنوی «There's two tickets»، اما در نوشتار و آزمون برای جمع از There are استفاده کن.

function.en: Say that something or somebody exists
function.fa: گفتن اینکه چیزی یا کسی وجود دارد

function.en: Describe a room, a street or a picture
function.fa: توصیف یک اتاق، خیابان یا تصویر

function.en: Answer 'What is in …?' and 'Is there any …?'
function.fa: پاسخ به «چه چیزی در … هست؟» و «آیا … هست؟»

function.en: Talk about events: There was a party last night.
function.fa: صحبت از رویدادها: There was a party last night.

examples.en: **There is a cat** under the table.
**There are three** empty seats.
**There was** an accident on the bridge.
**Is there** any butter left?
**There isn't** any milk in the fridge.

tip.en: Look at the noun that comes after the verb: singular or uncountable takes is / was, plural takes are / were. Never 'there have'.
tip.fa: به اسمی که بعد از فعل می‌آید نگاه کن: مفرد یا غیرقابل‌شمارش is / was می‌گیرد و جمع are / were. هرگز «there have» نگو.

q.fa: هفت روز در هفته وجود دارد.

q.fa: آیا صندلی‌ای در این اتاق هست؟

____ a beautiful view from the hill.

q.fa: در این خیابان سه بانک وجود دارد.

q.fa: امشب برنامه‌ی جالبی از تلویزیون پخش می‌شود.

q.en: ____ a lot of noise in the street last night.
q.fa: دیشب در خیابان سر و صدای زیادی بود.

structure.en: a  =  one of many, mentioned for the first time  →  a book, a dog
structure.fa: a  =  یکی از چندتا، اولین بار  →  یک کتاب

structure.en: an  =  before a VOWEL SOUND  →  an apple, an hour, but a university
structure.fa: an  =  قبل از «صدای» مصوت  →  یک ساعت، ولی a university

structure.en: the  =  specific, already known, or unique  →  the sun, the book I mentioned
structure.fa: the  =  مشخص، شناخته‌شده یا یکتا  →  خورشید، کتابی که گفتم

structure.en: Zero article  =  plurals & uncountables in general  →  Water is life. I like music.
structure.fa: بدون حرف  =  جمع‌ها و غیرقابل‌شمارش به‌طور کلی  →  آب زندگی است

structure.en: No article  =  most proper nouns, meals, languages, subjects  →  Tehran, lunch, English, math
structure.fa: بدون حرف  =  اسم خاص، وعده‌ها، زبان‌ها، درس‌ها  →  تهران، ناهار، انگلیسی، ریاضی

structure.en: the  with superlatives and sequences  →  the best, the first, the last
structure.fa: the با صفت تکراری و ترتیب  →  بهترین، اولین، آخرین

explain.en: a / an is decided by SOUND, not by spelling: an hour (silent h), an MP, but a university (yoo), a one-off.
explain.fa: انتخاب a یا an بر اساس صداست نه املا: an hour (ح بی‌صدا)، an MP، ولی a university (صدای یو) و a one-off.

explain.en: Uncountables and general plurals take no article: 'Life is short', 'Cats are clever'. Add 'the' only when you mean the specific ones.
explain.fa: اسم‌های غیرقابل‌شمارش و جمع‌های کلی حرف تعریف نمی‌گیرند: «Life is short»، «Cats are clever». فقط وقتی منظور مشخص است the می‌آید.

explain.en: First mention takes a/an, second mention takes the: 'I bought a book. The book was cheap.'
explain.fa: بار اول a/an و بار دوم the می‌آید: «I bought a book. The book was cheap.»

function.en: a / an introduces something new or not specific
function.fa: a / an چیزی نو یا غیرمشخص را معرفی می‌کند

function.en: the points to something already identified
function.fa: the به چیزی اشاره دارد که از قبل مشخص است

function.en: Used for unique things on Earth (the moon, the internet)
function.fa: برای چیزهای یکتای زمین (ماه، اینترنت)

function.en: Used with superlatives (the best, the tallest)
function.fa: با صفت‌های تکراری (بهترین، بلندترین)

function.en: Second mention takes 'the' — I bought a book. The book was cheap.
function.fa: دیدار دوم با the — یک کتاب خریدم. کتاب ارزون بود.

function.en: Jobs and nationalities take 'a' — a doctor, an Iranian
function.fa: مشاغل و ملیت‌ها با a — یک دکتر، یک ایرانی

examples.en: I saw **a** cat. It was **a** black cat.
She waited for **an** hour.
**The** sun rises in **the** east.
**The** book on **the** table is mine.
Water is important for life.
This is **the** best restaurant in town.

An hour later, the **other** train arrived.

tip.en: a/an for something new or unspecific, the for something already identified. Use 'an' before a vowel SOUND, not just a vowel letter.
tip.fa: a/an برای چیز نو یا نامشخص، the برای چیز مشخص. an قبل از «صدای» مصوت می‌آید، نه صرفاً حرف مصوت.

q.fa: موسیقی رو خیلی دوست دارم. (the / بدون حرف)

q.en: She lives in ____ Tehran, not ____ Shiraz.
q.fa: او در ____ تهران زندگی می‌کنه، نه ____ شیراز.

q.fa: برای تموم کردنش به ____ ساعت نیاز دارم.

q.fa: از ____ موزه در پاریس دیدن کردیم.

q.en: This is ____ second time I've been here.

structure.en: Subject:  I · you · he · she · it · we · they
structure.fa: فاعلی:   I · you · he · she · it · we · they

structure.en: Object:   me · you · him · her · it · us · them
structure.fa: مفعولی:   me · you · him · her · it · us · them

structure.en: Possessive adjective:  my · your · his · her · its · our · their
structure.fa: صفت ملکی:   my · your · his · her · its · our · their

structure.en: Possessive pronoun:  mine · yours · his · hers · ours · theirs
structure.fa: ضمیر ملکی:   mine · yours · his · hers · ours · theirs

structure.en: Reflexive:  myself · yourself · himself · herself · itself · ourselves · themselves
structure.fa: انعکاسی:   myself · yourself · himself · herself · ourselves · themselves

structure.en: he = male person, she = female person, it = thing or animal
structure.fa: he برای مرد، she برای زن، it برای اشیا و حیوانات

explain.en: After a verb or a preposition use the object form: 'for me', 'to him', 'with us' — never 'for I'.
explain.fa: بعد از فعل یا حرف اضافه حالت مفعولی می‌آید: «for me»، «to him»، «with us» — هرگز «for I».

explain.en: 'its' belongs to it (The dog wagged its tail); 'it's' means it is. The apostrophe always marks a contraction, never possession by a thing.
explain.fa: «its» یعنی ملکیتِ آن چیز (The dog wagged its tail)؛ «it's» یعنی it is. آپاستروف همیشه نشانه‌ی حذف است، نه ملکیت چیزها.

explain.en: Reflexives are for the same subject ('I hurt myself'), for emphasis ('I myself saw it') and for 'by + -self' = alone ('She lives by herself').
explain.fa: ضمیر انعکاسی برای هم‌فناعل بودن (I hurt myself)، برای تأکید (I myself saw it) و در عبارت by + -self به معنی تنها (She lives by herself) استفاده می‌شود.

function.fa: جایگزین اسم برای جلوگیری از تکرار

function.en: Subject pronouns come BEFORE the verb
function.fa: ضمایر فاعلی قبل از فعل می‌آیند

structure.en: Regular plural:  add -s  →  book → books
structure.fa: جمع منظم:   اضافه کردن s  →  کتاب → کتاب‌ها

structure.en: After -s, -x, -sh, -ch, -z  →  add -es  →  box → boxes, dish → dishes
structure.fa: بعد از s، x، sh، ch، z  →  es  →  جعبه → جعبه‌ها

structure.en: Consonant + y  →  y → ies  →  city → cities  |  vowel + y  →  add -s  →  boy → boys
structure.fa: y بعد از صامت  →  ies  →  شهر → شهرها  |  y بعد از مصوت  →  s  →  پسر → پسرها

structure.en: After -f / -fe  →  f → ves  →  wife → wives, leaf → leaves
structure.fa: بعد از f یا fe  →  ves  →  همسر → همسرها

structure.en: Irregular plurals must be memorised  →  man → men, child → children, foot → feet
structure.fa: جمع‌های بی‌قاعده باید حفظ شوند  →  مرد → مردان، بچه → بچه‌ها

structure.en: Never plural:  sheep, fish, series, information
structure.fa: بدون جمع:   sheep، fish، information

explain.en: Nouns ending in -o often take -es (potato → potatoes) but not always (photo → photos); -f and -fe often become -ves (knife → knives, wolf → wolves).
explain.fa: اسم‌هایی که به o ختم می‌شوند معمولاً es می‌گیرند (potato → potatoes) ولی نه همیشه (photo → photos)؛ f و fe معمولاً به ves تبدیل می‌شوند (knife → knives).

explain.en: Some nouns look plural but take a singular verb: news, physics, mathematics — 'The news is good', not 'are'.
explain.fa: بعضی اسم‌ها جمع به نظر می‌رسند ولی فعل مفرد می‌گیرند: news، physics، mathematics — «The news is good».

explain.en: Uncountables never take a/an or -s: 'three pieces of furniture', 'some advice', 'much money'.
explain.fa: اسم‌های غیرقابل‌شمارش نه a/an می‌گیرند و نه s: «three pieces of furniture»، «some advice»، «much money».

structure.en: Basic pattern:  Subject + Verb + Object  →  Ali eats apples.
structure.fa: الگوی پایه:   فاعل + فعل + مفعول  →  علی سیب می‌خوره.

structure.en: With adjective:  Subject + be + adjective  →  She is happy.
structure.fa: با صفت:   فاعل + be + صفت  →  او خوشحاله.

structure.en: Frequency adverb goes BEFORE the main verb: I always eat breakfast.
structure.fa: قید تکرار قبل از فعل اصلی می‌آید: من همیشه صبحانه می‌خورم.

structure.en: Question:  Question word + auxiliary + subject + verb
structure.fa: سؤال:   کلمه سؤال + فعل کمکی + فاعل + فعل

structure.en: Negative with do/does:  don't / doesn't + base verb
structure.fa: منفی با do/does:   don't / doesn't + فعل پایه

explain.en: Questions and negatives borrow an auxiliary (do / does / did, be, have) and move it before the subject: 'She works' → 'Does she work?'.
explain.fa: سؤال و منفی از فعل کمکی کمک می‌گیرند (do/does/did, be, have) و آن را قبل از فاعل می‌گذارند: «She works» → «Does she work؟».

explain.en: Adverbs of frequency (always, never, usually) go before the main verb but after 'be': 'She is always ready' ✓, 'She always is ready' ✗.
explain.fa: ظرف‌های تکرار (always, never, usually) قبل از فعل اصلی ولی بعد از be می‌آیند: «She is always ready» درست و «She always is ready» غلط است.

explain.en: Two verbs in a row need a connector: 'I want to go', 'I enjoy reading', 'I saw him running' — never 'I want go'.
explain.fa: دو فعل کنار هم به رابط نیاز دارند: «I want to go»، «I enjoy reading»، «I saw him running» — هرگز «I want go».

function.en: Prepositional phrases go at the end of the clause

function.en: Two verbs usually need 'and' or 'to' between them

structure.en: Wh- word + do / does / did + subject + base verb: Where do you live? / What does she want?
structure.fa: کلمه‌ی سؤالی + do/does/did + فاعل + فعل پایه: Where do you live? / What does she want?

structure.en: With be or a modal there is no 'do': Who is calling? / How can I help?
structure.fa: با be یا افعال وجهی «do» نمی‌آید: Who is calling? / How can I help?

structure.en: Yes/no questions have no question word: Are you coming?
structure.fa: سؤال بله/خیر کلمه‌ی سؤالی ندارد: Are you coming?

structure.en: Embedded questions keep statement order: Do you know where he lives? (not 'where does he live').
structure.fa: سؤال غیرمستقیم ترتیب جمله‌ی خبری دارد: Do you know where he lives? (نه «where does he live»).

structure.en: how much / how many for quantity · how long for time · what time for the clock.
structure.fa: how much / how many برای مقدار · how long برای مدت · what time برای ساعت.

structure.en: When the question word is the subject, there is no inversion: Who called you?
structure.fa: وقتی کلمه‌ی سؤالی خودش فاعل باشد جابه‌جایی نیست: Who called you?

explain.en: English needs a helper to ask a question. 'Where he lives?' is a statement with a question mark; add does — 'Where does he live?' — and the verb goes back to its base form.
explain.fa: انگلیسی برای سؤال به فعل کمکی نیاز دارد. «Where he lives?» یک جمله‌ی خبری با علامت سؤال است؛ does را اضافه کن — «Where does he live?» — و فعل به شکل پایه برمی‌گردد.

explain.en: An embedded question is a statement inside a question: 'Could you tell me where the station is?' The word order flips back to subject + verb and no extra 'does' appears, because the question is already carried by the first part.
explain.fa: سؤال غیرمستقیم یک جمله‌ی خبری داخل سؤال است: «Could you tell me where the station is?» ترتیب به فاعل + فعل برمی‌گردد و «does» اضافه نمی‌شود، چون بار سؤالی را بخش اول برداشته است.

explain.en: 'Who' can be the subject or the object. As subject it takes a normal verb: 'Who broke the window?' As object it needs the helper: 'Who did you invite?'
explain.fa: «who» می‌تواند فاعل یا مفعول باشد. اگر فاعل باشد فعل عادی می‌آید: «Who broke the window?» اگر مفعول باشد کمکی لازم است: «Who did you invite?»

structure.en: Opinion → size → age → shape → colour → origin → material → purpose: a lovely small old round brown Italian wooden coffee table.
structure.fa: نظر → اندازه → سن → شکل → رنگ → مبدأ → جنس → کاربرد: یک میز قهوه‌خوری چوبی ایتالیایی قهوه‌ای گِرد قدیمی کوچک و زیبا.

structure.en: Two adjectives of equal weight take a comma or 'and': a tall, thin man.
structure.fa: دو صفت هم‌وزن با ویرگول یا and جدا می‌شوند: a tall, thin man.

structure.en: -ing describes the thing itself; -ed describes how it makes you feel: a boring film / a bored class.
structure.fa: ing صفتِ خودِ چیز است و ed حسِ تو: فیلم خسته‌کننده / کلاس خسته.

structure.en: enough comes AFTER an adjective or adverb: big enough, quickly enough — but BEFORE a noun: enough money.
structure.fa: enough بعد از صفت یا قید می‌آید: big enough، quickly enough — ولی قبل از اسم: enough money.

structure.en: Adjectives never take a plural: a red car, two red cars.
structure.fa: صفت هرگز جمع نمی‌بندد: a red car، two red cars.

structure.en: else comes after the adjective: anyone else, something else.
structure.fa: else بعد از صفت می‌آید: anyone else، something else.

explain.en: English fixes the order of adjectives, so 'a red big car' sounds wrong to a native ear although every word is correct. Learn the chain as one unit: opinion-size-age-shape-colour-origin-material-purpose.
explain.fa: انگلیسی ترتیب صفت‌ها را ثابت نگه می‌دارد؛ بنابراین «a red big car» هرچند هر واژه‌اش درست است، برای یک انگلیسی‌زبان غلط به گوش می‌رسد. زنجیره را یک‌جا حفظ کن: نظر-اندازه-سن-شکل-رنگ-مبدأ-جنس-کاربرد.

explain.en: -ing means the thing causes the feeling and -ed means the person has it: 'The exam was difficult, so the students were worried.' 'The students were difficult' means something completely different.
explain.fa: «ing» یعنی چیز حس را ایجاد می‌کند و «ed» یعنی شخص آن حس را دارد: «The exam was difficult, so the students were worried». جمله‌ی «The students were difficult» معنی را کاملاً عوض می‌کند.

explain.en: 'enough' changes side with the word type: after an adjective (old enough, tall enough) but before a noun (enough time). Learners who learn one pattern use it everywhere and write 'enough big'.
explain.fa: «enough» با نوع واژه جایش عوض می‌شود: بعد از صفت (old enough) ولی قبل از اسم (enough time). کسی که فقط یک الگو یاد بگیرد همه‌جا «enough big» می‌نویسد.

function.en: Put several adjectives together and still sound natural
function.fa: چند صفت را پشت هم بیاور و باز طبیعی به گوش برسی

function.en: Say what you think of something before its facts
function.fa: نظرت را قبل از ویژگی‌های عینی بگو

function.en: Tell the cause (-ing) from the feeling (-ed)
function.fa: علت (ing) را از حس (ed) جدا کن

function.en: Place enough correctly the first time
function.fa: enough را بار اول درست بگذار

q.fa: فیلم خسته‌کننده است — دیگر هرگز تماشایش نمی‌کنم.

Origin before material: a ____ cotton shirt (Egyptian).
q.fa: مبدأ قبل از جنس: یک پیراهن نخی ____ (Egyptian).

q.fa: enough بعد از قید: او آن‌قدر خوب می‌خواند که قبول شود.

من به اندازه‌ی کافی گرسنه نیستم.

q.fa: دستورالعمل‌ها گیج‌کننده بود، برای همین گم شدیم.

q.fa: دو صفت هم‌وزن ویرگول می‌گیرند: یک مرد بلندقد و ____ (thin).

structure.en: Affirmative:  Subject + V2   (regular verbs: -ed → worked; irregulars: went, saw, wrote)
structure.fa: مثبت:   فاعل + فعل گذشته   (قواعدی: ed → worked؛ بی‌قاعده: رفت، دید، نوشت)

structure.en: Negative:     Subject + did not (didn't) + V1
structure.fa: منفی:   فاعل + did not (didn't) + فعل پایه

structure.en: Question:     Did + subject + V1 ?
structure.fa: سؤالی:  Did + فاعل + فعل پایه ؟

structure.en: Short answer: Yes, he did.  /  No, he didn't.
structure.fa: پاسخ کوتاه: Yes, he did.  /  No, he didn't.

structure.en: Note: after did / didn't the verb returns to its base form (V1).
structure.fa: نکته: بعد از did / didn't فعل به شکل پایه (V1) برمی‌گردد.

explain.en: 'did' already carries the past, so the main verb returns to its base form: 'Did you went' ✗ → 'Did you go' ✓.
explain.fa: چون did خودش گذشته را حمل می‌کند، فعل اصلی به شکل پایه برمی‌گردد: «Did you went» غلط و «Did you go» درست است.

explain.en: Irregular past forms must be memorised: go/went, buy/bought, think/thought, take/took, see/saw — there is no rule for them.
explain.fa: شکل گذشته‌ی بی‌قاعده باید حفظ شود: go/went، buy/bought، think/thought، take/took، see/saw — برای این‌ها قاعده‌ای وجود ندارد.

explain.en: Past time markers pin the sentence to the past: yesterday, last night, two days ago, in 2015 — never mix them with the present perfect.
explain.fa: قیدهای زمان گذشته جمله را قفل می‌کنند: yesterday، last night، two days ago، in 2015 — هرگز با حال کامل قاطی نشوند.

function.en: Completed actions at a finished time (yesterday, last week, in 2010)
function.fa: کارهای تمام‌شده در زمان مشخص گذشته (دیروز، هفته گذشته، در ۲۰۱۰)

function.en: A sequence of past actions (storytelling / narration)
function.fa: زنجیره‌ای از کارهای گذشته (روایت داستان)

function.en: Past habits and states that are no longer true
function.fa: عادت‌های گذشته که دیگر ادامه ندارند

function.en: Past events when the exact time is not mentioned
function.fa: رویدادهای گذشته بدون ذکر زمان دقیق

function.en: Common partners: ago, last…, when, yesterday
function.fa: همراهان پرتکرار: ago، last…، when، yesterday

examples.en: I **visited** my grandmother last week.
She **didn't call** me yesterday.
**Did** you **finish** your homework?
We **watched** a movie and **ate** pizza.
He **went** to Tehran in 2019.
When I was young, I **played** football every day.
examples.fa: وقتی بچه بودم، هر روز فوتبال **بازی می‌کردم**.

examples.en: We **didn't go** out because it was raining.
The film **began** at eight and **finished** at ten.
examples.fa: فیلم ساعت هشت **شروع شد** و ساعت ده **تموم شد**.

tip.en: Regular verbs add -ed, irregular verbs change (go → went, see → saw). Questions and negatives use did + base verb.
tip.fa: قاعده‌ها ed می‌گیرند، بی‌قاعده‌ها تغییر می‌کنند. سؤالی و منفی با did + فعل پایه می‌آید.

q.en: She ____ (go) to the cinema last night.
They ____ (be) very tired after the trip.
q.fa: بعد از سفر خیلی خسته ____ بودند.

q.en: She ____ not go to school yesterday. (do)
They ____ a great movie last night. (watch)
q.fa: آن‌ها دیشب یک فیلم عالی ____ کردند. (watch)

q.en: He ____ to the store an hour ago. (go)
q.fa: او یک ساعت پیش به مغازه ____ . (go)

q.en: He ____ a letter to his friend. (write)
She ____ a beautiful song at the party. (sing)
q.fa: او در مهمانی یک آهنگ قشنگ ____ خواند. (sing)

q.en: Last summer we ____ to the north of Iran. (travel)
q.fa: تابستان گذشته به شمال ایران ____ کردیم. (travel)

q.en: They ____ to the beach by car. (drive)
q.fa: آن‌ها با ماشین به ساحل ____ کردند. (drive)

q.en: ____ you see the film last night?
They ____ (buy) a new laptop last week.

structure.en: Affirmative:  Subject + will + V1   (I / he / she / it will go)
structure.fa: مثبت:   فاعل + will + فعل پایه   (I / he / she / it will go)

structure.en: Negative:     Subject + will not (won't) + V1
structure.fa: منفی:   فاعل + will not (won't) + فعل پایه

structure.en: Question:     Will + subject + V1 ?
structure.fa: سؤالی:  Will + فاعل + فعل پایه ؟

structure.en: Short answer: Yes, he will.  /  No, he won't.
structure.fa: پاسخ کوتاه: Yes, he will.  /  No, he won't.

structure.en: Plans & intentions:  Subject + am / is / are + going to + V1
structure.fa: برنامه‌ها و نیت‌ها:  فاعل + am/is/are + going to + فعل پایه

explain.en: 'will' is a decision made at the moment of speaking; 'be going to' is a plan already made — 'Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.'
explain.fa: will تصمیم لحظه‌ی گفتن است؛ be going to نقشه‌ای از قبل تعیین‌شده: «Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.»

explain.en: After will and going to the verb stays in the base form: 'will goes' ✗ → 'will go' ✓.
explain.fa: بعد از will و going to فعل پایه می‌آید: «will goes» غلط و «will go» درست است.

explain.en: In the negative, will contracts to won't and going to becomes wasn't / weren't going to: 'I won't tell anyone'.
explain.fa: در حالت منفی will به won't قرار می‌گیرد و going to به wasn't/weren't going to تبدیل می‌شود: «I won't tell anyone».

function.en: Predictions and guesses about the future
function.fa: پیش‌بینی‌ها و حدس‌ها درباره آینده

function.en: Promises, offers and threats (spontaneous decisions)
function.fa: قول، پیشنهاد و تهدید (تصمیم لحظه‌ای)

function.en: Facts that are always true in the future
function.fa: حقایقی که همیشه در آینده درست‌اند

function.en: Arrangements and plans (be going to)
function.fa: قرارها و برنامه‌های از پیش تصمیم‌گرفته (be going to)

function.en: Common partners: tomorrow, next…, soon, in 2030, I think
function.fa: همراهان پرتکرار: tomorrow، next…، soon، in 2030، I think

examples.en: I **will call** you tomorrow.
She **won't forget** your birthday.
**Will** you **come** to the party?
Look at those clouds! It **is going to rain**.
examples.fa: به اون ابرها نگاه کن! **می‌خواد بباره**.

examples.en: He **will be** a doctor one day.
We **are going to travel** next summer.
I **will have** finished by Friday, I promise.
examples.fa: تا جمعه **تمومش کرده خواهم بود**، قول می‌دم.

examples.en: Look at that car — it **will cost** a fortune.
examples.fa: اون ماشین رو ببین — کلی **خرج برمی‌داره**.

tip.en: will + base verb covers promises, predictions and decisions made now. 'be going to' is for plans already decided.
tip.fa: will + فعل پایه برای قول، پیش‌بینی و تصمیم همین حالا. be going to برای برنامه‌های قطعی.

q.en: He ____ be a doctor one day. (will)
The train ____ leave at 7 a.m. tomorrow. (will)
q.fa: فردا قطار ساعت ۷ صبح ____ حرکت کند. (will)

q.en: They ____ not come to the meeting. (will)
I ____ tell anyone — it's a secret. (will, negative)
q.fa: من به هیچ‌کس ____ بگویم — رازه. (will, منفی)

q.fa: به ابرها نگاه کن! ____ ببارد. (be going to)

q.en: We ____ travel next summer. (be going to, we)
q.fa: ما تابستان بعد ____ سفر برویم. (be going to)

q.en: She ____ graduate next year. (be going to, she)
q.fa: او سال بعد ____ فارغ‌التحصیل شود. (be going to)

q.en: I promise I ____ call you tomorrow. (will)
One day robots ____ do all the housework. (will)
q.fa: یک روز ربات‌ها ____ همه کارهای خانه را بکنند. (will)
به اون ابرها نگاه کن — ____ برف می‌باره.

structure.en: Affirmative:  am / is / are + V-ing   (I am eating · she is eating)
structure.fa: مثبت:   am / is / are + فعل ing   (I am eating · she is eating)

structure.en: Negative:     am / is / are + not + V-ing
structure.fa: منفی:   am / is / are + not + فعل ing

structure.en: Question:     am / is / are + subject + V-ing ?
structure.fa: سؤالی:   am / is / are + فاعل + فعل ing ؟

structure.en: Short answer: Yes, she is.  /  No, she isn't.
structure.fa: پاسخ کوتاه: Yes, she is.  /  No, she isn't.

structure.en: Spelling:  drop the final e (make → making)  ·  double the consonant (run → running)
structure.fa: املا:   حذف e پایانی (make → making)  ·  دو برابر کردن صامت (run → running)

structure.en: Note: use this tense for RIGHT NOW, not for permanent situations
structure.fa: نکته: این زمان برای «همین الان» است، نه برای کارهای دائمی

explain.en: -ing spelling: drop a final silent e (make → making), double the final consonant after a short vowel (sit → sitting, but see → seeing), -ie becomes -ying (lie → lying).
explain.fa: املای ing: e بی‌صدا حذف می‌شود (make → making)، بعد از مصوت کوتاه حرف بی‌صدا تکرار می‌شود (sit → sitting ولی see → seeing)، و ie به ying می‌رود (lie → lying).

explain.en: State verbs (know, like, want, believe, own, seem) are not used in the continuous: 'I know the answer', not 'I am knowing'.
explain.fa: افعال حالتی (know, like, want, believe, own, seem) استمراری نمی‌شوند: «I know the answer» درست است، نه «I am knowing».

explain.en: The present progressive can announce a fixed future arrangement with a time: 'I'm meeting her at six tomorrow'.
explain.fa: این زمان می‌تواند قرار آینده‌ی قطعی را هم برساند همراه با زمان مشخص: «I'm meeting her at six tomorrow».

function.en: Something happening at this moment
function.fa: کاری که همین الان در حال انجام است

function.en: Temporary situations around now (this week, this month)
function.fa: وضعیت‌های موقتی در حال حاضر (این هفته، این ماه)

function.en: Recent developments and changes (I am learning English now)
function.fa: تغییرات و اتفاقات اخیر (الان دارم انگلیسی یاد می‌گیرم)

function.en: Fixed future arrangements (I'm meeting Ali at 7)
function.fa: قرارهای قطعی در آینده نزدیک (ساعت ۷ علی را می‌بینم)

function.en: With verbs of state: be, know, want, like, love, believe — usually NOT used
function.fa: با افعال حالتی: be، know، want، like، love، believe — معمولاً استفاده نمی‌شود

function.en: Common partners: now, right now, at the moment, Look!, Listen!
function.fa: همراهان پرتکرار: now، right now، at the moment، نگاه کن!، گوش کن!

examples.en: I **am studying** English right now.
She **is waiting** for the bus.
They **aren't sleeping** — they're playing.
**Is** he **coming** with us tonight?
Look! It **is raining** again.

I'm **not** watching this film, I'm reading.
examples.fa: من این فیلم رو **نمی‌بینم**، دارم کتاب می‌خونم.

tip.en: am/is/are + V-ing for right now and temporary states. Never use it with verbs of state: I am knowing is wrong.
tip.fa: am/is/are + ing برای همین الان و حالت موقت. با افعال حالتی به کار نمی‌رود.

q.en: We ____ (not / use) the car this week.
q.fa: ما این هفته از ماشین ____ استفاده نمی‌کنیم.

q.en: He ____ (work) in a café at the moment.
q.fa: او الان دارد در کافه ____ کار می‌کند.

q.en: I ____ (not / work) today — it's Friday. (progressive negative)
q.fa: من امروز ____ کار نمی‌کنم — جمعه است. (منفی استمراری)
الا دقیقاً داری چه کار ____ ؟ (سؤالی استمراری)

q.en: They ____ (not / use) the gym this month. (progressive negative)
q.fa: آن‌ها این ماه از باشگاه استفاده ____ . (منفی استمراری)

q.en: Correct the sentence: "She is drink tea."  →  She ____ tea.
q.fa: جمله را اصلاح کنید: «She is drink tea.» →  او دارد چای ____ .
با -ing کامل کنید: make → ____  ·  run → ____  ·  write → ____
امشب ساعت ۸ قرار است داداشم را ____ . (قرار)

q.en: I ____ (read) this book at the moment.

structure.en: Affirmative:  was / were + V-ing   (I was eating · they were eating)
structure.fa: مثبت:   was / were + فعل ing   (I was eating · they were eating)

structure.en: Negative:     was / were + not + V-ing
structure.fa: منفی:   was / were + not + فعل ing

structure.en: Question:     Was / Were + subject + V-ing ?
structure.fa: سؤالی:   Was / Were + فاعل + فعل ing ؟

structure.en: Short answer: Yes, they were.  /  No, they weren't.
structure.fa: پاسخ کوتاه: Yes, they were.  /  No, they weren't.

structure.en: With was/were NOT followed by V-ing: I was tired. (not 'I was being tired')
structure.fa: بعد از was/were فعل ing نمی‌آید: I was tired. (نه 'I was being tired')

structure.en: Spelling:  drop the final e (write → writing)  ·  double the consonant (sit → sitting)
structure.fa: املا:   حذف e پایانی (write → writing)  ·  دو برابر کردن صامت (sit → sitting)

explain.en: The long action takes was / were + -ing and the short interrupting action takes the simple past: 'I was cooking when the phone rang.'
explain.fa: فعل طولانی was/were + ing می‌گیرد و فعل کوتاهِ قطع‌کننده ساده می‌ماند: «I was cooking when the phone rang.»

explain.en: was / were + -ing says the action was still running; was / were + adjective only describes a state: 'I was tired', not 'I was being tired'.
explain.fa: was/were + ing یعنی کار هنوز ادامه داشت؛ was/were + صفت فقط حالت را توصیف می‌کند: «I was tired» درست است نه «I was being tired».

explain.en: 'while' joins two long actions running in parallel: 'While I was studying, my brother was watching TV.'
explain.fa: while دو عمل طولانیِ هم‌زمان را به هم وصل می‌کند: «While I was studying, my brother was watching TV.»

function.en: An action in progress in the past (at a past moment)
function.fa: کاری که در گذشته در حال انجام بوده (در یک لحظه از گذشته)

function.en: Long actions that were interrupted by a short one
function.fa: کارهای طولانی که با یک کار کوتاه قطع شدند

function.en: Two actions happening at the same time (both in the past)
function.fa: دو کار که هم‌زمان در گذشته اتفاق افتادند

function.en: Background for storytelling and setting the scene
function.fa: پس‌زمینه برای داستان‌گویی و توصیف صحنه

function.en: With past continuous + past simple:  I was sleeping when he called.
function.fa: با گذشته استمراری + گذشته ساده:  داشتم خواب می‌کردم که زنگ زد.

function.en: Common partners: at 8 last night, all day, while, when, as
function.fa: همراهان پرتکرار: دیشب ساعت ۸، تمام روز، در حالی که، وقتی که

examples.en: I **was cooking** dinner at 7 o'clock.
They **were sleeping** when I arrived.
She **wasn't working** last Monday.
**Were** you **studying** yesterday evening?

examples.fa: در حالی که او داشت **آشپزی می‌کرد**، ما داشتیم **حرف می‌زدیم**.

examples.fa: وقتی بازی شروع شد، داشت **باران می‌بارید**.

examples.fa: در حالی که داشتیم **حرف می‌زدیم**، چراغ‌ها رفت.

examples.en: He wasn't listening; he **was daydreaming**.

tip.en: was/were + V-ing for an action in progress in the past, usually as the background for another past action.
tip.fa: was/were + ing برای کاری که در گذشته در جریان بوده، معمولاً پس‌زمینه یک کار دیگر.

q.en: We ____ (watch) TV when the lights went out.

q.fa: او دیشب از کامپیوتر استفاده ____ . (منفی استمراری)

q.en: It ____ (rain) when we left the house.
q.fa: وقتی از خانه بیرون زدیم، داشت ____ .

q.fa: داشتم کتاب ____ که چراغ‌ها خاموش شد. (استمراری)

q.fa: در آن لحظه درباره حرف ____ نمی‌زدند.

structure.en: Form:  modal + BASE verb (no 'to', no -s)  →  He can swim.
structure.fa: ساختار:   modal + فعل پایه (بدون to و بدون s)  →  او می‌تونه شنا کنه.

structure.en: Negative:  modal + not  →  She can't come.
structure.fa: منفی:   modal + not  →  اون نمی‌تونه بیاد.

structure.en: Question:  modal + subject + verb … ?  →  Can you help?
structure.fa: سؤالی:   modal + فاعل + فعل … ؟  →  می‌تونی کمک کنی؟

structure.en: have to / must = obligation   ·   don't have to = no obligation
structure.fa: have to / must = اجبار   ·   don't have to = بدون اجبار

structure.en: should = advice  ·  must = strong duty  ·  might / could = possibility
structure.fa: should = توصیه  ·  must = وظیفه  ·  might / could = احتمال

structure.en: Note: there is NO to + modal: ✗ He must to go.  ✓ He must go.
structure.fa: نکته: to قبل از modal نمی‌آید: ✗ must to go  ✓ must go

explain.en: A modal never takes -s and never takes 'to': 'He can swims' ✗ → 'He can swim' ✓, 'He must to go' ✗ → 'He must go' ✓.
explain.fa: فعل نما نه s می‌گیرد و نه to: «He can swims» غلط و «He can swim» درست است؛ «He must to go» غلط و «He must go» درست.

explain.en: can't = impossibility now, couldn't = past inability, mustn't = prohibition — the negative of obligation is 'don't have to', not 'mustn't'.
explain.fa: can't یعنی ناممکن بودن الان، couldn't یعنی ناتوانی گذشته، mustn't یعنی ممنوعیت — منفیِ الزام don't have to است نه mustn't.

explain.en: must has no past form for obligation (use had to) and no past participle — for regret use 'should have + V3'.
explain.fa: must برای الزام شکل گذشته ندارد (باید had to به کار برود) و وجه وصفی ندارد؛ برای پشیمانی از should have + V3 استفاده کن.

function.en: should / ought to — advice (You should see a doctor)
function.fa: should / ought to — توصیه (باید دکتر بری)

explain.en: Spelling: one-syllable adjectives add -er (tall → taller); two syllables ending in -y drop the y and add -ier (happy → happier); longer adjectives use more.
explain.fa: املای تفضیلی: صفت یک‌هجایی er می‌گیرد (tall → taller)؛ دوهجاییِ ختم‌شده به y حرف y را حذف و ier می‌گذارد (happy → happier)؛ بقیه با more ساخته می‌شوند.

explain.en: Never stack two comparative markers: 'more better' ✗ → 'better' ✓, 'very taller' ✗ → 'much taller' ✓.
explain.fa: هرگز دو نشانه‌ی مقایسه را روی هم نگذار: «more better» غلط و «better» درست؛ «very taller» غلط و «much taller» درست است.

explain.en: Position: before the main verb, after 'be', and at the very start when the adverb modifies the whole sentence — 'She always complains', 'She is always late', 'Unfortunately, she lost.'
explain.fa: جاگذاری: قبل از فعل اصلی، بعد از be، و در ابتدای جمله وقتی کل جمله را توصیف می‌کند — «She always complains»، «She is always late»، «Unfortunately, she lost.»

explain.en: hardly, barely and scarcely already carry a negative meaning, so 'I can't hardly' is a double negative — say 'I can hardly see'.
explain.fa: hardly و barely و scarcely خودشان منفی‌اند، پس «I can't hardly» دوگانه‌ی منفی است — بگو «I can hardly see».

explain.en: Adverbs of degree (very, quite, too, so) sit directly before the adjective or adverb they modify: 'very happy', never 'happy very'.

structure.en: Time: at = clock time (at 7:30) · on = days and dates (on Monday, on 5 May) · in = long periods (in summer, in 2026).
structure.fa: زمان: at برای ساعت (at 7:30) · on برای روز و تاریخ (on Monday) · in برای دوره‌های بلند (in summer, in 2026).

structure.en: Place: at = a point (at the bus stop) · on = a surface (on the wall) · in = an enclosed space (in the box, in Paris).
structure.fa: مکان: at برای نقطه (at the bus stop) · on برای سطح (on the wall) · in برای فضای بسته (in the box, in Paris).

structure.en: No preposition before next, last, this, every + time: next week, last night, every day.
structure.fa: قبل از next, last, this, every + زمان حرف اضافه نمی‌آید: next week، last night، every day.

structure.en: Fixed patterns: at night · in the morning · on Monday morning · at the weekend (BrE) / on the weekend (AmE).
structure.fa: الگوهای ثابت: at night · in the morning · on Monday morning · at the weekend (بریتانیایی) / on the weekend (آمریکایی).

structure.en: in time = not late · on time = at exactly the right moment.
structure.fa: in time یعنی دیر نرسیدن · on time یعنی دقیقاً سر وقت.

structure.en: at the corner of the street, but on Oxford Street — a point versus a line.
structure.fa: at the corner of the street، ولی on Oxford Street — نقطه در برابر خط.

explain.en: Think in three sizes. 'in' holds a whole period (in May, in winter), 'on' marks a named day or a surface (on Tuesday, on the table), 'at' pins one exact point (at 6 o'clock, at the door).
explain.fa: سه اندازه را در ذهن داشته باش. «in» یک دوره‌ی کامل را در بر می‌گیرد (in May, in winter)، «on» یک روز مشخص یا یک سطح را نشان می‌دهد (on Tuesday, on the table) و «at» یک نقطه‌ی دقیق را میخ می‌کند (at 6 o'clock, at the door).

explain.en: Learners write 'in Monday' because Persian puts a preposition before the day. English uses only 'on' for days: on Monday, on my birthday.
explain.fa: زبان‌آموزها «in Monday» می‌نویسند چون فارسی قبل از روز حرف اضافه می‌آورد. انگلیسی برای روزها فقط «on» دارد: on Monday، on my birthday.

explain.en: Time words that already point forward or back — next, last, this, every, tomorrow, yesterday — take no preposition at all: 'I saw her last Friday', not 'on last Friday'.
explain.fa: واژه‌های زمانی که خودشان به گذشته یا آینده اشاره دارند — next, last, this, every, tomorrow, yesterday — هیچ حرف اضافه‌ای نمی‌گیرند: «I saw her last Friday» نه «on last Friday».

function.en: Say when something happens: day, date, month, clock time
function.fa: گفتن زمان رویداد: روز، تاریخ، ماه، ساعت

function.en: Say where something is: a point, a surface, an enclosure
function.fa: گفتن مکان چیزی: نقطه، سطح، فضای بسته

function.en: Avoid the classic errors: in Monday, at morning, on next week
function.fa: پرهیز از خطاهای رایج: in Monday، at morning، on next week

function.en: Tell 'in time' from 'on time'
function.fa: تفاوت in time و on time

examples.en: The train leaves **on** Friday **at** 6:15 **in** the morning.

examples.fa: او **در** سال ۱۹۹۸، **در** یک روز سرد ژانویه به دنیا آمد.

examples.en: Leave your bag **on** the chair.

tip.en: Clock time = at · days and dates = on · months, years, seasons = in. Point = at · surface = on · inside = in. Nothing before next / last / this / every.
tip.fa: ساعت = at · روز و تاریخ = on · ماه، سال و فصل = in. نقطه = at · سطح = on · داخل = in. قبل از next / last / this / every هیچ.

structure.en: Countable → a / an · many · few · a number of
structure.fa: قابل‌شمارش → a / an · many · few · a number of

structure.en: Uncountable → much · little · a lot of · a piece of
structure.fa: غیرقابل‌شمارش → much · little · a lot of · a piece of

structure.en: some  =  positive / offering (I have some money)
structure.fa: some = مثبت یا پیشنهاد (یه کم پول دارم)

structure.en: any  =  negative or question (I don't have any money)
structure.fa: any = منفی یا سؤال (هیچ پولی ندارم)

structure.en: a lot of / lots of  =  both (a lot of books, a lot of water)
structure.fa: a lot of / lots of = هر دو (کتاب زیاد، آب زیاد)

structure.en: How much = uncountable · How many = countable
structure.fa: How much = غیرقابل‌شمارش · How many = قابل‌شمارش

explain.en: information, advice, furniture, news, money, luggage, bread and research are uncountable in English even though Persian counts them.
explain.fa: information, advice, furniture, news, money, luggage, bread و research در انگلیسی غیرقابل‌شمارش‌اند، هرچند فارسی آن‌ها را می‌شمارد.

explain.en: a few + countable (a few books) and a little + uncountable (a little water) both mean 'some'; without the article they mean 'almost none'.
explain.fa: a few با اسم شمارشی (a few books) و a little با اسم غیرشمارشی (a little water) هر دو یعنی «مقداری»؛ بدون حرف تعریف یعنی «تقریباً هیچ».

explain.en: In questions use some when a yes is expected ('Would you like some tea?') and any for real doubt ('Do you have any milk?').
explain.fa: در سؤال وقتی انتظار جواب بله داری some به کار برو («Would you like some tea?») و وقتی واقعاً مطمئن نیستی any («Do you have any milk?»).

function.en: Talking about quantities and amounts
function.fa: صحبت درباره مقدار و کمیت

function.en: Uncountables: water, money, rice, bread, information, advice, news, furniture
function.fa: غیرقابل‌شمارش: آب، پول، برنج، نان، اطلاعات، نصیحت، خبر، اثاثیه

function.fa: a few = چندتا (مثبت) · few = تقریباً هیچ (منفی)

function.en: 'A little' = some · 'little' = almost none
function.fa: a little = یه کم · little = تقریباً هیچ

function.en: 'A few' and 'a little' in questions means 'some?', not 'how many?'
function.fa: a few و a little در سؤال یعنی «چندتا؟» نه «چند تا؟»

tip.fa: many/few برای قابل‌شمارش، much/little برای غیرقابل‌شمارش، some و a lot of برای هر دو.

q.fa: چند تا دانش‌آموز تو کلاست هستن؟

q.fa: یه کم ____ لازم دارم — تو چی؟

structure.en: some + plural or uncountable, in offers and requests: Would you like some tea?
structure.fa: some + جمع یا غیرقابل‌شمارش، در تعارف و درخواست: Would you like some tea?

structure.en: any in negatives and questions: We don't have any milk. / Do you have any questions?
structure.fa: any در منفی و سؤالی: We don't have any milk. / Do you have any questions?

structure.en: no = not any, with a positive verb: I have no idea. / There is no milk.
structure.fa: no یعنی not any، با فعل مثبت: I have no idea. / There is no milk.

structure.en: every + singular noun · all + plural or uncountable: Every day is different. / All the water is gone.
structure.fa: every + اسم مفرد · all + جمع یا غیرقابل‌شمارش: Every day is different. / All the water is gone.

structure.en: much + uncountable and many + countable (mostly in negatives and questions); a lot of works with both.
structure.fa: much + غیرقابل‌شمارش و many + قابل‌شمارش (بیشتر در منفی و سؤالی)؛ a lot of با هر دو می‌آید.

structure.en: few / little = almost none · a few / a little = some: I have few friends. / I have a few friends.
structure.fa: few / little یعنی تقریباً هیچ · a few / a little یعنی کمی: I have few friends. / I have a few friends.

explain.en: some and any do not change the noun: some students (plural), some water (uncountable). The choice between them is about the type of sentence, not the type of noun — some for positive statements and offers, any for negatives and questions.
explain.fa: some و any اسم را تغییر نمی‌دهند: some students (جمع)، some water (غیرقابل‌شمارش). انتخاب بین آن‌ها به نوع جمله بستگی دارد، نه نوع اسم — some برای جمله‌ی مثبت و تعارف، any برای منفی و سؤالی.

explain.en: 'no' is shorter and stronger than 'not any': 'I have no money' = 'I don't have any money'. Watch the verb: 'no' keeps it positive, so 'I don't have no money' is a double negative.
explain.fa: «no» کوتاه‌تر و قوی‌تر از «not any» است: «I have no money» = «I don't have any money». به فعل دقت کن: با «no» فعل مثبت می‌ماند، پس «I don't have no money» منفیِ دوبل است.

explain.en: few and little mean almost none — the article changes everything: 'I have little time' (not enough) versus 'I have a little time' (enough for you).

structure.en: Form:  statement + opposite auxiliary + subject
structure.fa: ساختار:   جمله خبری + فعل کمکی مخالف + فاعل

structure.en: Positive statement → negative tag:  You're ready, aren't you?
structure.fa: جمله مثبت → تگ منفی:   آماده‌ای، نیستی؟

structure.en: Negative statement → positive tag:  You aren't ready, are you?
structure.fa: جمله منفی → تگ مثبت:   آماده نیستی، هستی؟

structure.en: With verbs: don't/doesn't ↔ do/does · is ↔ isn't
structure.fa: با افعال:   don't/doesn’t ↔ do/does  ·  is ↔ isn’t

structure.en: Use pronouns in the tag:  Ali is coming, isn't he?
structure.fa: در تگ از ضمیر استفاده کنید: علی داره میاد، نیست؟

structure.en: Invitations use 'will you':  I'll help you, will I?
structure.fa: دعوت‌ها با will you: کمکت می‌کنم، باشه؟

explain.en: The tag repeats the auxiliary of the statement and flips its polarity: positive statement → negative tag, negative statement → positive tag.
explain.fa: برچسب جمله فعل کمکیِ همان جمله را تکرار می‌کند و قطعیتش را برعکس می‌کند: جمله‌ی مثبت با برچسب منفی و بالعکس.

explain.en: After an imperative use 'will you?' and after 'let's' use 'shall we?': 'Open the door, will you?', 'Let's go, shall we?'.
explain.fa: بعد از جمله‌ی امری will you؟ می‌آید و بعد از let's صورت shall we؟: «Open the door, will you?»، «Let's go, shall we?»

explain.en: A rising tone asks a real question; a falling tone only asks the listener to agree — the words are identical.

structure.en: Affirmative:  Subject + have / has + V3
structure.fa: مثبت:   فاعل + have / has + فعل سوم (past participle)

structure.en: Negative:     Subject + have / has + not + V3
structure.fa: منفی:   فاعل + have / has + not + فعل سوم

structure.en: Question:     Have / Has + subject + V3 ?
structure.fa: سؤالی:   Have / Has + فاعل + فعل سوم ؟

structure.en: Short answer: Yes, she has.  /  No, she hasn't.
structure.fa: پاسخ کوتاه: Yes, she has.  /  No, she hasn't.

structure.en: Spelling of V3:  regular → -ed (worked)  ·  irregular → 3rd form (gone, seen, written)
structure.fa: املای فعل سوم:   قواعدی → ed (worked)  ·  بی‌قاعده → شکل سوم (gone, seen, written)

structure.en: Note: NO specific past time — not 'yesterday', not 'in 2019', not 'last week'
structure.fa: نکته: زمان دقیق گذشته نمی‌آید — نه «دیروز»، نه «سال ۲۰۱۹»، نه «هفته گذشته»

explain.en: Never combine it with a finished time: 'I have seen him yesterday' ✗ → 'I saw him yesterday' ✓.
explain.fa: هرگز با زمانِ پایان‌یافته قاطی نشود: «I have seen him yesterday» غلط و «I saw him yesterday» درست است.

explain.en: just, already and yet sit between have / has and the V3 in British English: 'I have just finished', 'She has already left', 'He hasn't arrived yet'.
explain.fa: just و already و yet در انگلیسی بریتانیایی بین have/has و فرم سوم می‌نشینند: «I have just finished»، «She has already left»، «He hasn't arrived yet».

explain.en: for = a length of time (for two years); since = a starting point (since 2023) — both need a verb that continues to now.
explain.fa: for یعنی مدت زمان (for two years) و since یعنی نقطه‌ی شروع (since 2023) — هر دو با فعلی به کار می‌روند که تا الان ادامه دارد.

function.en: A past action with a visible result NOW (I have lost my keys)
function.fa: کاری در گذشته با نتیجه‌ای که الان دیده می‌شود (کلیدمو گم کردم)

function.en: Life experience — with ever / never (Have you ever been to Rome?)
function.fa: تجربه زندگی — با ever / never (تا حالا روم رفته‌ای؟)

function.en: Unfinished time — with since / for (I have lived here for 5 years)
function.fa: زمان ناتمام — با since / for (۵ ساله اینجا زندگی می‌کنم)

function.en: Recent news (He has just left the building)
function.fa: خبرهای تازه (همین حالا ساختمون رو ترک کرده)

function.en: With already / yet / just / so far
function.fa: با already / yet / just / so far

function.en: Common partners: ever, never, already, yet, just, since, for, so far, recently
function.fa: همراهان پرتکرار: ever، never، already، yet، just، since، for، so far، recently

tip.fa: have/has + فعل سوم برای گذشته‌ای که حالا مهم است. زمان دقیق نمی‌آید: نه «دیروز» نه «سال ۲۰۱۹».

structure.en: Affirmative:  Subject + have / has + been + V-ing
structure.fa: مثبت:   فاعل + have / has + been + فعل ing

structure.en: Negative:     Subject + have / has + not + been + V-ing
structure.fa: منفی:   فاعل + have / has + not + been + فعل ing

structure.en: Question:     Have / Has + subject + been + V-ing ?
structure.fa: سؤالی:   Have / Has + فاعل + been + فعل ing ؟

structure.en: Short answer: Yes, he has.  /  No, he hasn't.
structure.fa: پاسخ کوتاه: Yes, he has.  /  No, he hasn't.

structure.en: With for / since:  I have been working here for 3 years.
structure.fa: با for / since:   ۳ ساله اینجا کار می‌کنم.

structure.en: Note: focus on the ACTIVITY and its duration, not the result
structure.fa: نکته: تمرکز روی «کار» و «مدتش» است، نه نتیجه

explain.en: Use it when the activity itself matters and its traces are visible: 'You're soaked — have you been walking in the rain?'.
explain.fa: وقتی خودِ فعالیت مهم است و اثرش پیداست به کار می‌رود: «You're soaked — have you been walking in the rain?»

explain.en: 'How long …?' invites this tense — 'How long have you been waiting?' — while 'How long did you wait?' closes the action in the past.
explain.fa: سؤال با How long این زمان را می‌طلبد — «How long have you been waiting?» — ولی «How long did you wait?» کار را در گذشته تمام‌شده نشان می‌دهد.

explain.en: State verbs stay in the simple form: 'I have known her for years', never 'I have been knowing'.
explain.fa: افعال حالتی در شکل ساده می‌مانند: «I have known her for years»، هرگز «I have been knowing».

function.en: An action that started in the past and is STILL going on
function.fa: کاری که در گذشته شروع شده و هنوز ادامه دارد

function.en: Emphasis on duration — for / since / all day / how long
function.fa: تأکید بر مدت زمان — for / since / all day / how long

function.en: The RESULT of a recent activity (I'm tired — I've been running)
function.fa: نتیجه یک فعالیت اخیر (خسته‌ام — کلی دویدم)

function.en: Repeated activities over a period (He has been calling me daily)
function.fa: کارهای تکرارشونده در یک بازه (هر روز بهم زنگ می‌زنه)

function.en: Have / has been TO = visited (once or more) in the past
function.fa: have / has been TO = در گذشته به جایی رفته و برگشته

function.en: Have / has been IN = lived / stayed there for a period
function.fa: have / has been IN = مدتی در آنجا زندگی کرده / مانده

examples.en: I **have been studying** for three hours.

**Have** you **been waiting** long?

examples.en: Your hands are dirty — you **have been gardening**.

tip.en: have/has been + V-ing for an activity that started in the past and is still going on — it stresses the activity, not the result.
tip.fa: have/has been + ing برای فعالیتی که از گذشته شروع شده و ادامه دارد — روی خود فعالیت تأکید دارد.

structure.en: Zero:   If + present, present  →  If it rains, we stay home.
structure.fa: صفر:   اگر + حال ساده، حال ساده  →  اگه بارون بیاد، خونه می‌مونیم.

structure.en: First:  If + present, will + V1  →  If it rains, we will stay home.
structure.fa: اول:   اگر + حال ساده، will + فعل پایه  →  اگه بارون بیاد، خونه می‌مونیم.

structure.en: Second: If + past, would + V1  →  If I were rich, I would travel.
structure.fa: دوم:   اگر + گذشته، would + فعل پایه  →  اگه پولدار بودم سفر می‌کردم.

structure.en: Third:  If + had + V3, would have + V3  →  If I had known, I would have helped.
structure.fa: سوم:   اگر + had + فعل سوم، would have + فعل سوم  →  اگه می‌دونستم کمک می‌کردم.

structure.en: Unless = if not:  Unless you hurry, you'll be late.
structure.fa: unless یعنی اگه … نباشه:  اگه عجله نکنی دیر می‌شی.

structure.en: Never put 'will' or 'would' in the if-clause (first and second type)
structure.fa: در بند if هرگز will/would نیاورید (نوع اول و دوم)

explain.en: Never put will or would inside the if-clause: 'If it will rain' ✗ → 'If it rains' ✓.
explain.fa: هرگز will یا would داخل جمله‌ی if نگذار: «If it will rain» غلط و «If it rains» درست است.

explain.en: The second conditional uses the past only to mark unreality, not past time — and 'were' is preferred for every person: 'If I were you'.
explain.fa: جمله‌ی شرطی نوع دوم فقط برای نشان دادن غیرواقعی بودنِ وضعیت می‌گیرد، نه زمان گذشته — و بعد از if برای همه‌ی اشخاص were ترجیح دارد: «If I were you».

explain.en: The third conditional is a closed past regret: If + had + V3, would have + V3 — never 'would have' inside the if-clause.
explain.fa: نوع سوم پشیمانیِ گذشته‌ی بسته است: If + had + V3، would have + V3 — هرگز would have داخل جمله‌ی if نمی‌آید.

function.en: Zero — general truths and laws (If you heat water, it boils)
function.fa: صفر — حقایق کلی و قانون‌ها (اگه آب رو گرم کنی می‌جوشه)

function.en: First — real and likely future (If I win, I'll buy a car)
function.fa: اول — آینده واقعی و محتمل (اگه ببرم، ماشین می‌خرم)

function.en: Second — unreal or imaginary present (If I had a million dollars)
function.fa: دوم — غیرواقعی یا خیالی حال (اگه یه میلیون دلار داشتم)

function.en: Third — unreal past / regret (If she had studied, she'd have passed)
function.fa: سوم — گذشته غیرواقعی / پشیمونی (اگه درس خونده بود، قبول می‌شد)

function.en: Mixed: If + past, will + V1 (I think I'll call you if I'm free tomorrow)
function.fa: ترکیبی:   اگر + گذشته، will + فعل پایه

function.en: 'What if' = What will happen if…?  'I wish' = unreal desire
function.fa: What if = چی میشه اگه …؟  ·  I wish = آرزوی غیرممکن

structure.en: Form:  Subject + be (correct tense) + V3  →  The door was opened.
structure.fa: ساختار:   فاعل + be (زمان درست) + فعل سوم  →  در باز شد.

structure.en: Present:  am / is / are + V3   ·   Past: was / were + V3
structure.fa: حال:   am / is / are + V3  ·  گذشته:   was / were + V3

structure.en: Future:  will be + V3  ·  Present perfect: has been + V3
structure.fa: آینده:   will be + V3  ·  حال کامل:   has been + V3

structure.en: Negative / question:  be + not + V3   ·   Be + subject + V3 ?
structure.fa: منفی / سؤالی:   be + not + V3  ·  Be + فاعل + V3 ؟

structure.en: Agent with 'by' (optional):  It was written **by** Shakespeare.
structure.fa: فاعل با by (اختیاری):  توسط شکسپیر نوشته شد.

structure.en: With modals:  can / must / should + be + V3  →  It can be fixed.
structure.fa: با modal:   can / must / should + be + V3  →  قابل تعمیره.

explain.en: The object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive: 'Ali wrote the report' → 'The report was written by Ali'.
explain.fa: مفعولِ جمله‌ی معلوم به فاعلِ جمله‌ی مجهول تبدیل می‌شود: «Ali wrote the report» → «The report was written by Ali».

explain.en: The auxiliary 'be' carries the tense and V3 never changes: is written · was written · will be written · has been written.

structure.en: Infinitive:  verb + TO + V1  →  I want to leave.

structure.en: Gerund:  verb + V-ing  →  I enjoy reading.
structure.fa: gerund:   فعل + ing  →  از خوندن لذت می‌برم.

structure.en: Verbs + gerund: enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, suggest, consider, keep
structure.fa: افعال + gerund:   enjoy، avoid، finish، mind، suggest، consider، keep

structure.en: Verbs + infinitive: want, decide, hope, plan, promise, agree, refuse
structure.fa: افعال + مصدر:   want، decide، hope، plan، promise، agree، refuse

structure.en: Verbs that change meaning:  stop to + V  /  stop + -ing
structure.fa: افعال با معنای متفاوت:   stop to + V  /  stop + ing

structure.en: After a preposition ALWAYS use the gerund:  good at swimming
structure.fa: بعد از حرف اضافه همیشه gerund:   خوب بودن در شنا کردن

explain.en: After every preposition the verb takes -ing: 'interested in learning', 'good at swimming', 'without saying goodbye'.
explain.fa: بعد از هر حرف اضافه فعل ing می‌گیرد: «interested in learning»، «good at swimming»، «without saying goodbye».

explain.en: Meaning pairs change with the form: 'stop to rest' = pause in order to rest; 'stop resting' = quit the activity. The same contrast holds for remember, forget and regret.
explain.fa: جفت‌های معنایی با شکل عوض می‌شوند: «stop to rest» یعنی برای استراحت مکث کردن، «stop resting» یعنی استراحت را کنار گذاشتن. همین تضاد در remember و forget و regret هست.

explain.en: Safe rule: intention verbs (want, decide, plan, hope) take to + V, enjoyment and avoidance verbs (enjoy, avoid, finish, mind) take -ing.
explain.fa: قاعده‌ی امن: افعال نیت (want, decide, plan, hope) با to + فعل و افعال لذت و پرهیز (enjoy, avoid, finish, mind) با ing می‌آیند.

explain.en: to / in order to share the subject of the main clause: 'I left early to catch the bus'. When the subject changes, use so that: 'I left early so that she could rest'.

explain.fa: so that معمولاً به فعل نما نیاز دارد (can, could, may, might, will): «so that he can speak» — فعل تنها در آنجا نادرست است.

explain.en: After because, since and as there is no inversion and no 'that': 'Because it rained, we stayed home' ✓.
explain.fa: بعد از because و since و as نه جابه‌جایی می‌آید و نه that: «Because it rained, we stayed home».

structure.en: Form:  reporting verb + (that) + clause
structure.fa: ساختار:   فعل گزارش + (that) + بند

structure.en: Backshift of tenses:  present → past, will → would, am/is/are → was/were
structure.fa: عقب‌بردن زمان‌ها:   حال → گذشته، will → would، am/is/are → was/were

structure.en: Past perfect stays past perfect: had + V3 → had + V3
structure.fa: گذشته کامل باقی می‌ماند:   had + V3 → had + V3

structure.en: say (no object) vs tell + object:  He said (that)… / He told me (that)…
structure.fa: say بدون مفعول، tell با مفعول:   گفت … / بهم گفت که …

structure.en: Questions become:  if / whether + question word + clause order
structure.fa: سؤال‌ها می‌شوند:   if / whether + کلمه سؤال + ترتیب جمله

structure.en: Requests / commands:  He asked me to wait.  He told me not to wait.
structure.fa: درخواست/دستور:   ازم خواست صبر کنم.  گفت صبر نکنم.

explain.en: say vs tell: 'say something (to someone)' but 'tell someone something' — 'He said me' ✗ → 'He told me' ✓.
explain.fa: تفاوت say و tell: say چیزی (به کسی) می‌گوید و tell به کسی چیزی می‌گوید — «He said me» غلط و «He told me» درست.

explain.en: If the reporting verb is past, the tense shifts back one step; if it is present or the fact still holds, the tense need not shift: 'He says he is tired'.
explain.fa: اگر فعل گزارش‌دهنده گذشته باشد زمان یک قدم عقب می‌رود؛ اگر حال باشد یا حقیقت هنوز برقرار، نیازی به عقب رفتن نیست: «He says he is tired».

explain.en: Yes / no questions become if / whether and lose the question order: 'Are you coming?' → 'He asked whether I was coming'.
explain.fa: سؤال‌های آری/خیر به if یا whether تبدیل می‌شوند و ترتیب سؤالی را از دست می‌دهند: «Are you coming?» → «He asked whether I was coming».

function.en: Reporting what someone said without quoting them directly
function.fa: بازگویی گفته کسی بدون نقل‌قول مستقیم

function.en: Questions → if / whether or a question word
function.fa: سؤال‌ها → if / whether یا کلمه سؤال

function.en: Commands → ask/tell + object + to + V

structure.en: Typical pattern:  Past Perfect (earlier) + Simple Past (later)

explain.en: You need it only when two past events compete: the earlier one becomes had + V3, the later one stays in the simple past.
explain.fa: فقط وقتی لازم است که دو رویداد گذشته رقابت کنند: رویداد قدیمی‌تر had + فرم سوم و رویداد جدیدتر ساده می‌ماند.

explain.en: had is identical for every person: I had, she had, they had — there is no 'hads' and no helping verb in questions beyond 'had'.
explain.fa: had برای همه‌ی اشخاص یکسان است: I had، she had، they had — نه «hads» داریم و نه در سؤال چیزی جز خودِ had کمکی می‌شود.

explain.en: When before, after, when or by the time already fixes the order, the simple past is also correct: 'After he arrived, we ate.'
explain.fa: وقتی before، after، when یا by the time ترتیب را از قبل مشخص کرده باشند، گذشته‌ی ساده هم درست است: «After he arrived, we ate».

explain.en: The pattern is fixed: modal + have + V3 — never 'modal + had' and never 'did': 'You should have told me' ✓.

explain.en: must have + V3 = sure it happened; can't have + V3 = sure it did not; might / may have + V3 = possible but uncertain.

explain.en: shouldn't have + V3 criticises something that did happen ('You shouldn't have shouted'), while don't have to only removes present obligation.

structure.en: Inseparable (no object between):  look **after** the baby ✓ / look the baby after ✗
structure.fa: جدانشدنی:   نگهداری از بچه ✓ / … ✗

structure.en: The particle changes the meaning:  look (نگاه کردن) → look after (مواظبت)

explain.en: With a noun object a separable phrasal verb splits either way — 'turn off the light' / 'turn the light off' — but a pronoun must go in the middle: 'turn it off', never 'turn off it'.
explain.fa: با مفعولِ اسم می‌توان جدا کرد: «turn off the light» یا «turn the light off» — ولی ضمیر حتماً وسط می‌رود: «turn it off»، هرگز «turn off it».

explain.en: Inseparable phrasal verbs (look after, run into, consist of, depend on) never take an object in the middle: 'look after the baby' ✓.
explain.fa: فعل مرکبِ جدانشدنی (look after, run into, consist of, depend on) هرگز مفعول وسط نمی‌گیرند: «look after the baby».

explain.en: The particle changes the meaning completely: look up (search) vs look up to (respect) vs look after (care for) — learn them as whole units.
explain.fa: قیدِ جمله معنی را کامل عوض می‌کند: look up (جست‌وجو) در برابر look up to (احترام گذاشتن) در برابر look after (مواظبت) — آن‌ها را به‌صورت واحد حفظ کن.

explain.en: wish + past simple speaks about the present: 'I wish I knew' means I do not know now — the tense steps back, not the time.
explain.fa: wish + گذشته‌ی ساده درباره‌ی حال است: «I wish I knew» یعنی الان نمی‌دانم — زمان فعل عقب می‌رود، نه زمان واقعی.

explain.en: wish + would is for other people's behaviour or a future change: 'I wish he would listen' — never 'I wish I would be rich' for your own state.
explain.fa: wish + would برای رفتار دیگران یا تغییر آینده است: «I wish he would listen» — برای وضعیت خودت از would استفاده نکن.

explain.en: would rather + base verb for yourself, but + past simple for another person's action: 'I'd rather stay' / 'I'd rather you stayed'.
explain.fa: would rather برای خودت با فعل پایه می‌آید و برای کارِ دیگران با گذشته‌ی ساده: «I'd rather stay» / «I'd rather you stayed».

explain.en: A cleft splits one sentence in two: 'She left in 2019' → 'It was in 2019 that she left' — the emphasised piece sits between was and that.
explain.fa: جمله‌ی تأکیدی یک جمله را دو تا می‌کند: «She left in 2019» → «It was in 2019 that she left» — تکه‌ی تأکیدی بین was و that می‌نشیند.

explain.en: Use a what-clause when the emphasised part is a thing or a whole idea: 'What I need is time', 'What surprised me was his calm'.
explain.fa: وقتی چیزِ تأکیدی یک شیء یا یک ایده‌ی کامل است از what استفاده کن: «What I need is time»، «What surprised me was his calm».

explain.en: The verb after the focus must agree with the real subject: 'It is the students who are ready', not '…who is ready'.
explain.fa: فعل بعد از تأکید با فاعل واقعی جمع می‌شود: «It is the students who are ready»، نه «…who is ready».

function.en: Used to correct a misunderstanding, contrast, or emphasise one element while the rest goes quiet. Very common in speech, writing and exam answers.
function.fa: برای رفع سوءتفاهم، مقایسه یا پررنگ کردن یک عنصر است در حالی که بقیه کم‌رنگ می‌شود. در گفتار، نوشتار و پاسخ آزمون بسیار رایج است.

structure.en: Mix a **past** condition with a **present** result — and the other way round.
structure.fa: یک شرط گذشته را با نتیجه حال بیامیزید — و برعکس

structure.en: Past + present:  If + had + past participle, would + infinitive.
structure.fa: گذشته + حال:  اگر + had + اسم مفعول، would + مصدر

structure.en: If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now.
structure.fa: اگر پزشکی خوانده بودم، الان پزشک بودم

structure.en: Present + past:  If + simple present, would have + past participle.
structure.fa: حال + گذشته:  اگر + حال ساده، would have + اسم مفعول

structure.en: If I weren't so afraid of flying, I would have gone to Lisbon.
structure.fa: اگر این‌قدر از پرواز نمی‌ترسیدم، به لیسبون رفته بودم

structure.en: The mix happens because **one part is finished** and the **other is still true**.
structure.fa: ترکیب به این دلیل است که یک بخش تمام شده و بخش دیگر هنوز برقرار است

explain.en: Past condition → present result: If + had + V3, would + V1 — 'If I had taken that job, I would be in Berlin now'.
explain.fa: شرطِ گذشته با نتیجه‌ی حال: If + had + V3، would + فعل پایه — «If I had taken that job, I would be in Berlin now».

explain.en: Present condition → past result: If + simple past, would have + V3 — 'If I weren't so shy, I would have spoken up'.
explain.fa: شرطِ حال با نتیجه‌ی گذشته: If + گذشته‌ی ساده، would have + فرم سوم — «If I weren't so shy, I would have spoken up».

explain.en: The two halves must really be different times; if both are past it is a normal third conditional, if both are present a second.
explain.fa: دو نیمه باید واقعاً زمان‌های متفاوتی داشته باشند؛ اگر هر دو گذشته باشند نوع سوم معمولی و اگر هر دو حال باشند نوع دوم است.

function.en: Express regret about the past and a consequence that is still affecting you now. Very frequent in speech.
function.fa: پشیمانی از گذشته و نتیجه‌ای که هنوز روی تو اثر دارد را بیان می‌کند. در گفتار بسیار پرتکرار است.

structure.en: have / get + object + past participle = **you arrange it, someone else does it**.

structure.en: Notice the difference: *I repaired my car* = I did it myself.
structure.fa: تفاوت را ببین: *ماشینم را تعمیر کردم* = خودم انجام دادم

explain.en: The pattern keeps three parts: have / get + object + past participle — the object is the thing acted on, not the person doing the work.
explain.fa: الگو سه جزء دارد: have/get + مفعول + فرم سوم — مفعول همان چیزی است که رویش کار می‌شود، نه کسی که کار می‌کند.

explain.en: You can still say who did it and when: 'I had my teeth checked by a dentist', 'We had the roof fixed last week'.
explain.fa: می‌توانی بگویی چه کسی و چه زمانی: «I had my teeth checked by a dentist»، «We had the roof fixed last week».

explain.en: Never drop the participle: 'I had the car wash' ✗ → 'I had the car washed' ✓ — and only use it when someone else did the work.
explain.fa: فرم سوم را حذف نکن: «I had the car wash» غلط و «I had the car washed» درست — و فقط وقتی دیگری کار را کرده باشد این الگو درست است.

function.en: Say clearly that the work was outsourced. Extremely common and often misunderstood by learners, who drop the middle noun.
function.fa: روشن می‌گوید که کار را کس دیگری انجام داده است. بسیار رایج است و زبان‌آموزان اغلب اسم میانی را حذف می‌کنند.

structure.en: Three times combine: **modal + perfect + infinitive**.
structure.fa: سه زمان با هم ترکیب می‌شوند: **modal + perfect + infinitive**

structure.en: Past obligation / regret:  should have, could have, might have (done).
structure.fa: وظیفه یا پشیمانی گذشته:  should have، could have، might have

structure.en: Past deduction:  must have, can't have, may have (done).
structure.fa: استنتاج درباره گذشته:  must have، can't have، may have

structure.en: Future obligation about the past:  might/must/should have to (do).
structure.fa: احتمالِ ناگزیر بودن:  might/must/should have to

explain.en: Read the stack from left to right: the modal gives the attitude and have + V3 puts the event in the past — should (advice) → should have (regret).
explain.fa: از چپ به راست بخوان: فعل نما نگرش را می‌دهد و have + فرم سوم رویداد را در گذشته می‌گذارد — should (نصیحت) → should have (پشیمانی).

explain.en: Never use 'did' with a modal: 'He must have gone' ✓, 'He must have did it' ✗ — modals already carry the grammar.
explain.fa: هرگز did با فعل نما نیامیزد: «He must have gone» درست و «He must have did it» غلط — خودِ فعل نما بار دستوری را حمل می‌کند.

explain.en: may / might have to + V1 is future obligation, not the past: 'You may have to resit the exam'.
explain.fa: may/might have to + فعل پایه یعنی الزام آینده، نه گذشته: «You may have to resit the exam».

function.en: Talk about the past with three different meanings: blame, deduction and unavoidable consequence.
function.fa: با سه معنای متفاوت درباره گذشته حرف می‌زند: سرزنش، استنتاج و نتیجه‌ای که اجتناب‌ناپذیر است.
